topics.label: Course introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the cancer biology lecture series and outlines the specific learning objectives for the session.

topics.label: Cancer as a disruption of cellular genetics, differentiation, and tissue architecture
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define cancer fundamentally as a progressive failure of genetic regulation, cellular differentiation, and tissue architecture, while addressing the laboratory models used to investigate these processes.

topics.label: Benign versus malignant tumors: invasion, metastasis, and progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the biological and pathological distinctions between benign and malignant neoplasms, focusing on basement membrane invasion, metastatic routes, and stepwise histological progression.

topics.label: Tumor nomenclature and classification conventions
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines the standard terminology and naming exceptions used to classify benign and malignant neoplasms across different tissue types.

topics.label: Mechanisms of cancer morbidity and mortality
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the physiological and anatomical mechanisms through which local tumor growth and widespread metastases cause clinical illness and death.

topics.label: Comparative tumor incidence across humans and other species
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine patterns of tumor frequency across human tissue types and populations, as well as in other animal species as a feature of multicellular life.

topics.label: Clinical detection and cancer screening modalities
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss the clinical rationale, histological basis, and diagnostic efficacy of population screening programs across various cancer types.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and practical reminders
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding remarks, revisits the learning outcomes, and gives housekeeping details for upcoming practicals.
